waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: keep-held-wait-on-new-user-run
mutations.why: sync() no longer ends a held wait when the user starts a new run (#judge's `fact.running && !fact.lastRun` clause covers only the probe): flush later sends retry into the user's live run.

mutations.name: probe-ignores-session-change
mutations.why: #verifyNetwork's continuation stops comparing the session file and `touched` count: a session or branch change during the probe still ends in a held wait and a retry.

mutations.name: marker-ignores-wait
mutations.why: deriveMarkers stops giving awaitingConnection the `network` reason: a crash during the wait no longer retries.
mutations.search: IF awaiting[ct] THEN "network" ELSE IF stopped[ct] THEN "none"
mutations.replace: IF FALSE THEN "network" ELSE IF stopped[ct] THEN "none"

mutations.name: fire-hold-without-sync
mutations.why: F1 as it was: #fire hands the attempt to the connection wait offline and returns without sync(), so the marker file is not rewritten while the wait holds.
mutations.search: /\ pc' = "s_watch" /\ ct' = t /\ rp' = rp        \* the sync() after #hold in #fire

mutations.name: held-wait-ignores-session-change
mutations.why: F4 as it was: #movedSince never sees a move, so neither #judge, flush nor the continuation after whenReady ends the wait, and flush retries the failed turn into the session the tab shows now.

mutations.name: flush-skips-recheck
mutations.why: Review M1: flush() runs a held wait without looking again; a move no sync() saw (a paired device's switch on an idle tab) retries into the new session.

mutations.name: ready-skips-recheck
mutations.why: Review minor 2: #run sends once the omp is up without looking again; a move while the omp started (after flush, or after a scheduled retry fired) retries into the new session.

mutations.name: launch-hold-records-no-session
mutations.why: launch() as it was: the relaunch's offline wait records no session or branch (wsg at the bound, so no later change counts), and flush continues the marker into the session the tab shows now.

mutations.name: fire-keeps-armed-row-on-hold
mutations.why: #fire stops releasing the scheduled retry before it hands the attempt to the connection wait: the tab shows a wait and a scheduled retry at once.

mutations.name: unshared-probe
mutations.why: verify() starts a probe for every ask instead of sharing the one in flight for the host.

mutations.name: offline-when-either-fails
mutations.why: #reachable needs both asks to answer (`every` instead of `includes(true)`): a mistyped provider URL alone takes the state offline.

mutations.name: remove-fairness-wait
mutations.why: Nothing forces the runtime to run what is queued: a held wait may stay forever.

mutations.name: remove-fairness-probe
mutations.why: Nothing forces the probe to answer: a probe row may stay forever.

mutations.name: flush-leaves-wait-row
mutations.why: flush() runs the continuation but forgets setAwaitingConnection(false): the wait row never goes.
mutations.search: /\ awaiting' = [t \in Tabs |-> IF waiting[t] THEN FALSE ELSE awaiting[t]]

mutations.name: probe-answer-lost
mutations.why: The probe's answer never reaches the waiting tab (the .then is never called): the probe row stays.
mutations.search: IN /\ vRes' = vRes \cup {<<w[1], w[2], result>> : w \in vW}

mutations.name: flush-ignores-move-in-flight
mutations.why: Finding 3 (review of v0.82.0): `#run` does not wait for a move command that is on its way (`movesSettled`); flush() sends the first command while `touched` has not counted the move yet, so it runs in the session the tab is about to show.

mutations.name: fire-ignores-move-in-flight
mutations.why: Finding 3: a scheduled retry that fires while a move command is on its way sends stock retry at once instead of waiting for the answer (`#fire`/`#run` skip movesSettled).

mutations.name: restore-done-skips-recheck
mutations.why: Finding 2: the launch continuation's second command (stock retry, the unwritten prompt, the goal resume) goes out after a slow `restore_interrupted` without looking at the session and branch again, so a tab that moved meanwhile gets it in the other session.

mutations.name: cancel-forgets-launch-goal
mutations.why: Finding 1: Cancel / the resuming row's Stop drops the held launch continuation without goalSettled `cancelled`, so Autopilot (`#awaitingResume`) waits for ever and the board shows running while nothing runs.
mutations.search: /\ apWait' = [apWait EXCEPT ![t] = IF waiting[t] /\ waitFor[t] = LaunchO THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]]

mutations.name: drop-forgets-launch-goal
mutations.why: Finding 1: a new prompt or a session or branch move on a held tab drops the launch continuation in sync() without goalSettled `cancelled`.
mutations.search: IF drop /\ waiting[t] /\ waitFor[t] = LaunchO THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]
mutations.replace: IF FALSE THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]

mutations.name: flush-forgets-moved-launch-goal
mutations.why: Finding 1: flush() lets a held launch wait go and its tab moved: the continuation ends without telling Autopilot.
mutations.search: IF t \in moved /\ waitFor[t] = LaunchO THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]
mutations.replace: IF FALSE THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]

mutations.name: continuation-abort-forgets-goal
mutations.why: Finding 2: a continuation that looks again once the omp is up (or a move's answer is in) and finds its tab moved ends without goalSettled.
mutations.search: apWait' = [apWait EXCEPT ![t] = IF o = LaunchO THEN FALSE ELSE apWait[t]]

mutations.name: run-ignores-persons-prompt
mutations.why: A11 before its fix: `#run` does not compare `ResumeFact.prompted`; a person's prompt while the continuation waits for a move's answer or its omp is not told from the continuation's own run, and stock retry (or the launch's restore) goes out after it.

mutations.name: restore-ignores-persons-prompt
mutations.why: A11 before its fix: after a slow `restore_interrupted` the launch's second command (stock retry, the unwritten prompt, the goal resume) goes out although the person sent a prompt meanwhile.
